meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 macOS 菜单栏为 NanoClaw 添加一个闪电图标。图标带绿点表示运行中，红点表示已停止；点击图标可以启动、停止或重启 NanoClaw 服务。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器，或提到关键词“add-macos-statusbar”时触发。技能仅适用于 macOS，并需要 Xcode 命令行工具。

say.note: 会编译并安装对应状态栏程序。

say.text: 运行 /add-macos-statusbar 命令来添加状态指示器。
say.note: 会执行该技能的标准流程。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude adds a bolt icon in the macOS menu bar for NanoClaw. A green dot means NanoClaw is running, a red dot means it is stopped. Clicking the icon starts, stops, or restarts NanoClaw.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw or mention the keyword 'add-macos-statusbar'. It requires macOS with Xcode Command Line Tools.

say_en.text: Please add a menu bar status icon for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: This will trigger the skill and start checking the environment.

say_en.text: Help me show NanoClaw's running status in the macOS menu bar.
say_en.note: This will compile and install the status bar program.

say_en.text: Run /add-macos-statusbar to add the status indicator.
say_en.note: This will follow the skill's standard steps.
